rubric_items.reason: All eight acceptance criteria map to REQ-1..REQ-15; sorting/searching, reason entry and the API fact are out of scope with reasons.
Prior F-2 fixed: status filter, date range and paging are now REQ-8, REQ-14, REQ-15. Prior F-1 fixed: REQ-9 now shows stored reason or "-" per REQ-4. Each REQ is one checkable behaviour.
Every known REQ cites a ticket line, the baseline or an IDE answer (A-01, A-02); all seven claims check out against ticket, baseline, glossary and generated context.
The ticket-vs-schema clash (always a reason vs nullable column) was asked, answered in A-01 and recorded as a mismatch citing both ticket lines; no baseline conflict found.
Two precise questions with real options and defaults, both answered by an engineer; none open, none blocking needlessly.
Plain wording; glossary terms Cancelled, Scheduled, Completed, No-show, Dashboard, Medical history, Front-desk staff used consistently.

cites.quote: A cancelled appointment always has a reason of up to 300 characters, entered when it is cancelled;
Medical history appears only on the patient's own page, never in lists, the dashboard or logs.
An appointment called off before it took place, with a reason
